card.line: Cherith is a brook valley east of the Jordan where God sent Elijah to hide and cared for him during a time of drought.

moments.title: God sends Elijah to hide
moments.text: The LORD tells Elijah to turn eastward and hide by the Brook of Cherith. He promises that Elijah will drink from the brook and that ravens will feed him there.

moments.title: Ravens bring food
moments.text: Elijah obeys and lives by the brook. Each morning and evening the ravens bring him bread and meat, and he drinks from the brook.

moments.title: The brook dries up
moments.text: After some time the brook dries up because there has been no rain. Then the LORD sends Elijah on to Zarephath, where a widow will provide for him.
